summary: The document defines the structure for generating maintenance guidelines using VBScript with session state disabled. It includes a screen name variable and a virtual include for further processing.
purpose: To provide a web-based screen for maintenance guidelines, using server-side VBScript for processing.

fields.name: strScreenName
fields.description: Holds the screen name for the maintenance guideline interface.

workflows.name: Maintenance Guideline Execution
steps: Include virtual processing script via DoScreen.asp

system_behavior.description: The VBScript disables session state and buffers response, creating an environment for web-based interactions without storing session information.
